Definition: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
BiblicalUsage: Batach means to trust, to be confident, to lean on with assurance. Proverbs says to trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding, Isaiah says God keeps in perfect peace the mind that is stayed on Him because it trusts in Him, the psalm says it is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in man, and Jeremiah says blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe trust is the whole of faith in one word, because it is not agreeing that God is true but leaning on Him with all your weight. The man who trusts in man is cursed and the man who trusts in the Lord is blessed, and I hold that the difference is not the size of the trouble but the place of the trust.
